quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #12
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: When making a turn, you must ____ your speed.
questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce
questions.explanation: When turning, reduce your speed so you can control your vehicle, stay in your lane, and react to surprises.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a full stop and wait for all vehicles and pedestrians to pass before moving forward.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. In wet conditions, slow down, avoid sudden braking or turning, and increase the distance between your car and the car ahead.

questions.question: When driving behind a transit bus that is signaling to enter a traffic lane:

options.text: Quickly pass the bus before it re-enters traffic.
Yield the right-of-way to the transit bus.
Expect the bus to yield the right-of-way to you.
Either yield the right-of-way or don't yield the right-of-way. There is no specific rule.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield the right-of-way to the transit bus.
questions.explanation: You must yield to a transit bus when it signals to enter traffic. Change lanes or slow down to let the bus merge safely.

questions.question: Certain highway signs contain information about hazardous conditions. Such signs are known as:
questions.correctAnswerText: Warning signs.
questions.explanation: Warning signs tell drivers about dangerous conditions ahead. Follow these signs to stay safe. Ignoring them can cause accidents.

questions.question: When the driver behind you wants to pass, you should:

options.text: Slow down to allow room in front of your vehicle for the other driver to complete the pass easily.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down to allow room in front of your vehicle for the other driver to complete the pass easily.
questions.explanation: Slow down so the other driver has enough space to pass safely and quickly.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign means a traffic light is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: Roads freeze quickly when they are:
questions.correctAnswerText: Shaded.
questions.explanation: In cold or wet weather, shaded areas freeze first and dry last. Be extra careful on roads under trees or buildings.

questions.question: When you see or hear an emergency vehicle coming, you should:

options.text: Stop immediately and let the vehicle pass.
Drive as far toward the right side of the road as is safe and stop.
Proceed slowly and permit the vehicle to pass.
Keep moving slowly, staying to the right side of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drive as far toward the right side of the road as is safe and stop.
questions.explanation: Move to the right side of the road as safely as you can and stop. Do not stop in an intersection. This applies whether the emergency vehicle is coming toward you or from behind.

questions.question: A stop sign is shaped like a(n):
questions.correctAnswerText: Octagon.
questions.explanation: Stop signs are eight-sided. All eight-sided signs mean you must come to a full stop.

questions.question: Which of the following is true about driving on a wet roadway?

options.text: As you drive faster, your tires become less effective.
Water does not affect cars with good tires.
Deep water is less dangerous than shallow water.
As you decrease your speed, the roadway becomes more slippery.

questions.correctAnswerText: As you drive faster, your tires become less effective.
questions.explanation: When driving fast on wet roads, your tires cannot remove water as well. If you go too fast, your tires lose grip and you may hydroplane, or slide on water.

questions.question: Motor vehicles are required to have:

options.text: A license plate only on the front.
A license plate only on the back.
License plates on both the front and back of the vehicle.
License plates, but only if the driver chooses to have them.

questions.correctAnswerText: License plates on both the front and back of the vehicle.
questions.explanation: You must display license plates on the front and back of your vehicle. Every registered vehicle must have them to drive on public roads.

questions.question: A person who drives much slower than the speed limit:

options.text: Should not let following cars pass.
May create a dangerous driving environment.

questions.correctAnswerText: May create a dangerous driving environment.
questions.explanation: Driving much slower than traffic can be dangerous. On a two-lane road with cars backing up behind you, pull over and let them pass. Only drive slowly when conditions require it.

questions.question: You are approaching a railroad crossing with no gates or flashing lights, but it has a standard crossbuck sign. What should you do?

options.text: Approach the tracks with extreme caution and cross only when you are sure no train is coming.
Turn your radio down so you can hear if a train is approaching.
Only continue when a flagger tells you it is safe, if one is present.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Approach all railroad crossings with extreme caution. Cross only when you are sure no train is coming from any direction. Always obey a flagger's instructions.

questions.question: What is the "No zone"?

options.text: A term for blind spots around a truck or bus.
A roadway with restrictions on vehicle stereo volume.
The television show that replaced The Twilight Zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: A term for blind spots around a truck or bus.
questions.explanation: Trucks and buses have blind spots on the sides, rear, and front. Cars in these blind spots cannot be seen by the truck or bus driver. These areas are called the "No zone."

questions.question: How can you reduce the risk of hydroplaning?
questions.correctAnswerText: Drive slower.
questions.explanation: Hydroplaning happens when you drive too fast on wet roads. Slowing down reduces the risk of hydroplaning.

questions.question: What does a red traffic light mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: A red light means you must stop before entering the intersection. Stop at the stop line and before entering any crosswalk.

questions.question: A flashing red traffic light has the same rules as:
questions.correctAnswerText: A stop sign.
questions.explanation: When you see a flashing red light, you must stop and yield to all traffic that does not have to stop.

questions.question: When passing on a multilane highway, what should you do?

options.text: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
You do not need to signal.

questions.correctAnswerText: Make sure the passing lane is clear.
questions.explanation: Before passing, make sure the passing lane is clear. Always use your turn signal to show you are changing lanes.

questions.question: You turn onto a two-lane road with a broken yellow line down the middle. What does this tell you?

options.text: You are on a two-way road.
You are on a one-way road.
You must stay to the left of the broken yellow line.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are on a two-way road.
questions.explanation: Yellow centerlines separate traffic moving in opposite directions. A broken line means you may cross it to pass slower traffic when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do before changing lanes?

options.text: Turn your head to check for other vehicles.

questions.correctAnswerText: All of the above.
questions.explanation: Check your side and rearview mirrors for traffic behind you. Before moving into the other lane, turn your head and check your blind spot for any vehicles.

questions.question: How can you avoid alcohol-related crashes?

options.text: Decide before drinking that you will not drive.
Say "No thanks, I'm driving" if someone offers you a drink.

questions.correctAnswerText: Do any of the above.
questions.explanation: Decide before you start drinking that you will not drive. Alcohol affects your judgment, so it is harder to make safe decisions after drinking.

questions.question: What causes "highway hypnosis"?

options.text: Staring at the road for long periods of time.
Getting too much sleep the night before.

questions.correctAnswerText: Staring at the road for long periods of time.
questions.explanation: Highway hypnosis happens when you stare ahead at the road for too long and stop looking around you. This makes you likely to miss traffic slowing or stopping ahead.

questions.question: Unless posted otherwise, what is the speed limit on narrow, winding mountain highways?
questions.correctAnswerText: 20 mph
questions.explanation: The speed limit on narrow, winding mountain highways is 20 mph unless a sign says otherwise. Always follow posted speed limit signs.

questions.question: What must you do when driving near a motorcycle?

options.text: Allow the motorcycle to use a complete lane.
Drive on the shoulder beside the motorcycle.
Allow the motorcycle to use only half a lane.
Pass using the same lane as the motorcycle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Allow the motorcycle to use a complete lane.
questions.explanation: A motorcycle is a full vehicle with the same rights as other vehicles. Give a motorcycle a full lane width so it can maneuver safely.
